findings.description: As the olives are poured, the stream of falling olives is rendered in front of the near-side rim of the large receiving jar. Since they are falling into the jar's opening, they should be occluded by the front rim.

During the second pour, the bottom edge of the small pouring jar and the falling olives are again rendered overlapping the front rim of the large jar, violating the expected depth ordering for objects entering the opening.
